value.rationale: The canonical triangle-inflated Petersen Tietze graph is a motivated non-Hamiltonian cubic model. Exact full recurrent orbit, transient, basin and spatial-symmetry classification resolves a precise natural invariant missing from the compared literature; the 137 two-cycles coexist with two 776-state consensus basins, and the sharp entry bound differs from the uninflated Petersen benchmark. The fact is a complete finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
